# DSH Whale Pet
A lightweight, pixel-art companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) (`dsh-whale-pet`) that adds an
animated whale pet above the input composer during new sessions.
Drawn in the style of the DeepSeek whale logo, this little companion keeps you company when opening
a fresh conversation and automatically tucks away once you start chatting.
## Features
- **Animated Pixel Art**: Handcrafted inline SVG sprite that bobs, blinks, flaps its tail, and spout

s water every few seconds.
- **Interactive**: Click or tap the whale anytime to make it perform an i

nstant hop and water spout.
- **Unobtrusive**: Appears exclusively on empty new sessions and gracefu

lly disappears the moment you send a message or start a run.
- **Lightweight & Crisp**: Rendered wit
h crisp pixel rendering (`shape-rendering: crispEdges`) and stepped CSS keyframes without heavy exte

rnal asset dependencies.
- **Accessible**: Automatically halts animations when `prefers-reduced-moti

on` is enabled in system settings.
- **Localization**: Supports English (`en`) and Chinese (`zh`) ac
cessibility descriptions.
## How It Works

- Hooks into the `conversation.input.dock` slot directly above the composer card.
- Evaluates sessio
n activity (`blank && !running && !promptAttempted`) so it stays completely out of the way during ac

tive conversations.
- Renders as a self-contained inline SVG using CSS step-timing functions to emul
ate classic retro sprite sheets.
